alerts.headline: IndiGo jumps nearly 5%, Asian Paints gains 2% as aviation, tyre, oil marketing stocks rally amid crude slump
alerts.summary: IndiGo surged nearly 5 percent, while Asian Paints, Apollo Tyres and oil marketing stocks gained as Brent crude's nearly 25 percent plunge over 10 days lifted sentiment. Brent rebounded to $92.20 a barrel on Wednesday amid renewed Middle Ea
second_order_candidates: Winner: Crude-input users (IndiGo: ATF is its largest cost; Asian Paints: crude-linked solvents and pigments; tyre makers: carbon black and synthetic rubber; OMCs: marketing margin widens while pump prices stay fixed).

Losers: Upstream producers whose realisation tracks Brent (ONGC, OIL India, Reliance's upstream/refining spread) lose revenue per barrel; the earlier ONGC-vs-HPCL pair (crude-ongc-vs-hpcl) is already closed, so no live leg is hurt.
Catalyst: surprise - crude slump driver not stated in the headline (fell from ~105 in mid-Oct to ~95-99 in early Nov); a round-up of sector moves, not a single new fact.
Thesis fit: none (crude-ongc-vs-hpcl is closed; its rule triggered on 6 Nov). No draft: the move is already in prices and the cause is unclear, a coin flip.
